admission.justification: Invented endpoint resolution or an archive fallback over a present live owner would publish unverifiable requirement authority. Changed-link/deferred-row checks prevent that mistake without promoting informational validator observations into a commit gate.

applicability: Requirement-owner selection, the Writer changeset endpoint checks, deferred planned requirement references and validator endpoint observations.
conditions: Resolve the live task directory first; only when it is absent may the corresponding tasks/<repository>/0_archive task directory supply the owner. A present but unresolved active owner is not bypassed.

With coordination authority, newly added or changed unresolved record links refuse before publication; unchanged unresolved links remain observations and absence of coordination authority is not fabricated resolution.
A deferred planned requirement reference must resolve at its owner or the row refuses with correction guidance.
Endpoint documents expose authored occurrence states and archive provenance as observations; they do not turn requirement endpoint observations into validator commit refusals.
exclusions: Requirement-owner resolution is separate from packet approval/latest-version policy, record-link path currentness and task-question publication.
No archive move, task write, execution result or validation/commit/MEMORY acceptance is performed by this guarantee.
statement: Requirement endpoints resolve live or archived owners, newly authored unresolved links and deferred requirements refuse in the Writer, and validator endpoint observations never refuse a commit route.
